summary: Emma Ford contacted HomeNet support because she was still being charged for a canceled service after the cancellation date. The agent investigated and identified an incorrect charge from seven days later. They issued a full refund to her account, which will be processed within three to five business days via email. Finally, Emma received instructions on how to return the router as part of the process.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly identified Emma’s name and account number.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with being charged twice, expressing understanding of their situation.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm tone throughout the conversation, avoiding interruptions and using polite language.

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue ("I was still charged") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Emma's name and account details.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions about the charge, such as "When did you cancel?" and “What is the date of the charge?”

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent clearly stated the refund timeframe and provided a prepaid return label.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent initiated the full refund process.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue, even though it was an error on their end.

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Emma’s concerns without interrupting or becoming defensive.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the refund had been processed and provided a confirmation email.

compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

response_times.client_text: I cancelled last week but I was still charged. I'd like a refund.
response_times.agent_text: I'm sorry about that, let me look into it for you right away.
Can I confirm your name and account number to verify the account?
Thank you, Emma. I can see your cancellation was processed on the fifth.
And there's a charge dated the seventh, after your cancellation, so that shouldn't have gone out.
I'll refund that charge in full now. It'll be back in 3 to 5 business days.

response_times.client_text: Great. Do I need to return the router?
response_times.agent_text: Yes, I'll email you a prepaid return label so it costs you nothing.
You'll get the refund confirmation and the label in one email. Anything else I can help with?

response_times.client_text: No, that covers it. Thank you.
response_times.agent_text: You're welcome, take care and have a good day.
